summary: Bộ thu thập Golang agentic skills cho AI coding assistant, cho phép tự động hóa tác vụ phát triển với Claude, Codex, Gemini và Cursor
usecases: Build custom AI coding agents that can execute specific development tasks in Go environments
Extend Claude Code or Codex with domain-specific skills for backend or system programming
Create vibe-coding workflows where AI agents autonomously handle code refactoring, testing, or deployment using Go-based skills
ideas: Deploy as a microservice for scalable AI agent task distribution across multiple Go workers
Integrate with opencode or Gemini CLI to create a multi-LLM agent orchestration platform
Use as a foundation for autonomous software development bots that learn and apply engineering best practices over time
